title: Several families of incommensurable noncompact hyperbolic Coxeter polytopes
summary: We classify all 141 finite-volume hyperbolic Coxeter five-dimensional polytopes with eight facets, of which 125 are noncompact. Using maximal-cusp density and a noncompact analog of Bogachev-Douba-Raimbault's argument, we construct infinitely many pairwise incommensurable noncompact Coxeter polytopes in dimensions 4, 5, 6, 7, and 9, with the number of commensurability classes growing at least exponentially in volume.
